visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a ponytail wearing a black halter top and a man in a Guy Fawkes mask sit at a wooden table with cookies and tea. The man places cash on the table, and the woman looks surprised with wide eyes. (2) In a retail clothing store with hangers of jackets, the woman tries to pay for items. The masked man stops her hand and presents his smartphone showing a digital barcode. The woman looks enamored and covers her mouth. (3) The two are seated indoors against a neutral wall. The woman shows a picture of a handbag on her phone to the man. He holds up his phone screen showing the LINE Pay interface, gesturing for her to pay. (4) The woman speaks directly into the camera in a medium close-up, using expressive hand gestures to explain a concept. The lighting is bright and even. (5) High-speed screen recordings of a mobile interface display various menus, a transfer of 66 NTD, and a bank top-up of 1,000 NTD, featuring green checkmark icons. (6) On a light gray sofa, a man's hand reaches into the frame, followed by a young boy with glasses who leans in close to the camera, smiling mischievously while holding a smartphone. (7) The woman returns to a close-up framing, looking directly at the viewer with a subtle, knowing smile against a plain indoor background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music with a strong synthesizer bassline starts immediately. A female voice speaks with high energy and rapid articulation about a social gathering. (2) A sharp digital 'whoosh' sound effect marks a scene transition. The female voice exhibits a higher pitch and exaggerated excitement. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'click' digital UI sounds occur as the woman mentions mobile payments. (4) The music continues at a steady pace. The female narrator transitions into an informative, instructional tone, speaking clearly and continuously with very few pauses. (5) A rhythmic 'ding' sound effect repeats as green checkmarks appear on screen, signifying successful financial transactions. (6) A lower-pitched male voice enters briefly, followed by the bright, sharp voice of a child asking a question. (7) A final melodic jingle plays as the female voice concludes with a friendly sign-off, and the music fades out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Situational Conflict -> Solution/Tutorial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the convenience and ease of use of LINE Pay Money for splitting bills and transferring money to family members, including children.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the app, brand logos visible throughout, and a call to follow the official Instagram account.
